inputs.utterance: Create a calc to Bin max lifetime deal amount into High, medium, low buckets based on thresholds 100K and 200K

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: {IF [Largest Opportunity Amount] <= 100000 THEN 'Low' ELSEIF [Largest Opportunity Amount] > 100000 AND [Largest Opportunity Amount] <= 200000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END}
